verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents an end-to-end pipeline from a reported bug (via the feedback widget) to an 'intention' with proposed tasks, which a coding agent (Claude Code/Codex) can claim and act on autonomously to open a PR (docs-3, docs-4, docs-35, docs-37). However, the workflow explicitly requires human approval of the task contract before any agent work runs ('Nothing runs until a person approves a contract' — docs-7), and other docs describe manually copying the intention into a coding agent (docs-31), so full autonomous diagnose-and-fix without human gating is not evidenced. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on proof of an agent successfully diagnosing and fixing a real bug end-to-end, and confirmation that diagnosis itself (not just task execution) is agent-driven without human intervention.
